title: IntentMandate
description: A user-authorized spending intent: the outer bound an agent may act within before any cart exists.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this intent mandate.

max_paise.description: Maximum amount, in paise (1/100 INR), this intent authorizes.

expiry_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which this intent is no longer valid.

allowed_categories.description: Merchant/product category slugs this intent may be spent against.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this mandate was issued.

signature.description: Optional base64-encoded signature of the mandate payload by the user's agent/key.
